text: 4.1 Part 1 Like a lot of people, I used to have a pretty fixed routine each day, and I often felt bored and frustrated. I used to dream of winning the lottery and having an exciting life. Then I came across an article that changed the way I think. It said, you don't need to do Do anything major to make life more interesting. Just try a few simple changes. The article went on to give some suggestions and here are a few examples. Take a different route to work or school. Cook one new dish every week. Have lunch with someone you don't know well at work or school. Start a conversation with a stranger every day. Find free activities to do in the evenings and at weekends. Call a different friend or relative every week.
